_classes.name: model actor_unit dropped at ingest (body inside or convened by an agency stored with agency_unit null)
_classes.rule: model_unit is non-null and agency_unit is null (subset agency=='Governor': 31)

_classes.name: State actor overridden by a locality found in the text (agency set to a local group though the model resolved a State body)
_classes.rule: agency_group in {Cities,Towns,Villages,Counties,School districts,Fire districts} and actor_resolved_model matches ^(the )?(state |new york state )?(liquor authority|division of|department of|office of|governor|commissioner|comptroller|state ) and has no town/village/city/county/district word

_classes.name: Quote taken from reprinted unchanged text of an amended section (no overlap with braced new matter)
_classes.rule: rebuild post-amendment packet text (drop [..], mark {{..}}), locate quote; flag when quote overlaps no braced char and the enclosing act section header says 'amended' but not 'by adding' (7519 records checkable)

_classes.name: Effective clause 'N year(s)/month(s) after it shall have become a law' left unparsed (effective_date null)
_classes.rule: effective_dates[law].rule=='unparsed' and raw_clause matches '(year|month)s? after it shall have become a law' (74 laws; 199 unparsed laws overall, 146 records with null effective_date); records counted

_classes.name: Part-level effective dates of omnibus laws not applied (records in a later-dated Part inherit the act's general date)
_classes.rule: effective_dates raw_clause mentions 'Part(s) X' and section_dates is empty (65 laws); records in those laws = candidate set, needs per-Part check

_classes.name: Precondition-triggered duty given on_effective_date (e.g. a campus 'seeking to sponsor' must submit a plan; notice 'prior to submitting')
_classes.rule: deadline_kind=='on_effective_date' and quote/action_summary matches (seeking to|prior to submitting|before submitting|must submit|upon (a|the)? (request|receipt|application)|if (a|the|any)) (regex is narrow; judgment needed for recall)

_classes.name: designation_no_actor gate drops real provisions whose actor is in the clause ('designated by the board of trustees') or in the list lead-in ('the trustees shall have power: ... to participate')
_classes.rule: dropped rule=='designation_no_actor' and (quote contains 'by the ' or starts with 'to ') : 95 of 316 such drops
